authority_boundary: Peer topology manifests declare expected public-safe route coverage for configured peer gossip only.
Peer topology manifests do not discover peers, probe peers, open sockets, copy files, send gossip, use ADB, launch apps, execute commands, or execute validation slots.

Peer topology manifests do not carry private endpoint values, raw network addresses, raw device identifiers, gossip bodies, commands, shell text, ADB targets, pairing material, install requests, or launch requests.
